_comment: Questions an operator might ask, per command. They bridge everyday wording and the manual's wording in search. Keys are command names; keys starting with _ are ignored.
add ldev: create a new ldev in a pool
carve a volume out of a parity group
extend ldev: increase the size of an ldev
modify ldev: make a volume a command device
turn on capacity saving for a volume
change the mp blade of a volume
set the tiering policy of a volume
turn a volume into a command device
set the command device attribute on an ldev
add lun: map a volume to a host group
present a volume to a host
assign a lun to a host
give the server access to a volume
add a path to a volume
delete lun: unmap a volume from a host group
take a volume away from a host
get lun: list volumes mapped to a host group
which volumes does the host see
add host_grp: add a host group to a port
make a host group for a new server
delete host_grp: remove a host group from a port
get host_grp: show host groups on a port
add hba_wwn: add a host wwpn to a host group
add an hba to a host group
delete hba_wwn: remove a wwn from a host group
get hba_wwn: show wwns in a host group
list the hbas registered to a host group
add hba_iscsi: add an iqn to a target
modify port: set an mtu on a port
set the vlan on a port
enable lun security on a port
add dp_pool: add a volume to a pool
get dp_pool: show tiering information of a pool
modify pool: turn a pool into a tiered pool
rename pool: change the name of a pool
get parity_grp: which drives are in parity group 1-1
add parity_grp: build a raid 6 group from drives
get command_status: what is the status of my request id
check progress of the last command
lock resource: prevent others from changing the configuration
add device_grp: add ldevs to a device group
delete device_grp: remove an ldev from a device group
add copy_grp: make a copy group for replication
set up a copy group for gad
add journal: create a journal group for universal replicator
add quorum: create a quorum for global-active device
map resource: add a volume to a resource group
move an ldev into a resource group
assign resources to a virtual storage machine
add snapshot: take a snapshot of a volume
add path: add a path to external storage
add nvm_subsystem: create an nvme over tcp subsystem
add nvm_subsystem_port: add a port to an nvm subsystem
attach an nvme tcp port to a subsystem
add host_nqn: add the host nqn to a subsystem
add namespace: add a namespace to a subsystem
map an ldev to a namespace
add namespace_path: give a host access to a namespace
map a namespace to a host nqn
get system: show the array model and serial number
what firmware is the array running
get chap_user: show chap users on a port
send ping: test connectivity from a storage port to an ip address
add server: add a server for nvme or iscsi
